purpose: Test the final puzzle-letter bit and identify the native DS:60D8 completion/transition behavior.

static_scan.method: 16-bit disassembly of file-backed QUIKY.EXE segments 1-6; direct absolute DS:60D8 operands plus the selector/main-loop caller
static_scan.reader_mask_change: 01F7:5940 reads DS:60D8, compares prior DS:60DA, XORs the changed bits, and dispatches presentation updates through 01F7:386F
static_scan.level_transition_gate: The caller at 01D7:4F10 tests DS:85DB and jumps to 01D7:4FAF; that branch copies DS:85D4 to DS:85D6, maps the selector state, and enters 01D7:5017 (relocated target 01F7:0908), 01D7:5038 (0227:0D5A copy), 01D7:503D (01F7:1AAA), 01D7:5042 (01F7:321F), and 01D7:5047 (local 01D7:313D rebuild/dispatch).
static_scan.direct_reference_count_scope: semantic sites (writer, changed-bit reader, main-loop comparator), not every repeated operand inside the reader
static_scan.interpretation: The final-letter callback writes DS:60D8, the 01D7 main-loop completion routine owns the all-seven comparator and presentation, and DS:85DB is the explicit handoff into the level-transition state machine.
static_scan.outer_state_gate: 01D7:4EA0 tests DS:89E6; its positive branch 01D7:4EAA calls the completion/effect consumer at 01D7:14E1. The normal cloud callback 01F7:9269 writes DS:89E6=0xFFFF when the player is in range.
static_scan.presentation_wait_helper: 0207:10A9 samples PIT channel 0 through ports 43h/40h, compares the sample with DS:97F4, retries while equal, and stores the changed sample at 0207:1113.

transition_gate_census.interpretation: The terminal value 0xFFFF is written only by the outer gameplay/completion branches; initialization and transition-loop paths clear the gate. The downstream resource path is therefore controlled by both the completion handoff and the transition-loop state, not by the final-letter callback alone.

completion_flag_census.interpretation: 01D7:1704 sets the flag after the all-seven presentation; 01D7:4B34 sets it for selector transition states 0x10-0x14; 01D7:16BF clears it on the non-final comparator path.

runtime_probe.fixture: W1L1 entity-7f-native baseline; source ARE record 0x1792 mutated from type 0x2B to type 0x7F; runtime declaration offset 0x1632

refined_presentation_probe.interpretation: The refined probe arms only the authored comparator, presentation, and transition addresses; none fire in this synthetic W1L1 fixture despite DS:60D8 reaching 0x007F.

gated_presentation_probe.interpretation: Forcing the real outer-state prerequisite reaches the authored comparator and both completion strings, sets DS:85DB=1, and adds 2000 points. The probe then remains in the presentation/effect continuation; 01D7:4FAF-5047 transition setup was not reached within the bounded post-sequence window.

gated_wait_probe.interpretation: The diagnostic reached and returned from one PIT wait before the completion strings, then ended its bounded post-message run inside the same timer helper at 0207:10CB; no 4FAF-5047 transition address fired.

current_stage_writer_probe.fixture: main-tree QUIKY.EXE with an isolated W1L1 type-0x7F baseline archive variant at a near-camera anchor
current_stage_writer_probe.interpretation: Within this bounded current-script diagnostic, the forced outer cloud gate reaches the completion consumer and PIT wait helper but none of the known END stage writers fire; DS:88AE remains zero. This is a negative timing boundary, not evidence that the fully authored boss/end transition never advances the stage.

transition_release_probe.fixture: W1L1 type-0x7F synthetic final-letter archive variant from the main-tree QUIKY.EXE/NESTLE.DAT
controls: force DS:89E6=0xFFFF to enter the real outer completion consumer
release the segment-4 PIT compare at 0207:10D3/10EE/1107 in debugger memory
release the post-bonus audio/UI loops at 01D7:01D6/01F0
force DS:89E0=0 at 01D7:4FAF and patch the diagnostic copy of 01D7:5010 to fall through
transition_release_probe.interpretation: Controlled release of the authored presentation/audio/input waits now proves the native DS:85DB handoff through 01D7:4F10-4FAF and the selector advance to 0x10. The downstream 01D7:5017/5038/5047 resource/object calls remain statically resolved but did not fire in this synthetic fixture even after the DS:89E0 gate was forced; this is a runtime-boundary result, not evidence that the retail reload branch is absent.

transition_release_capacity_probe.fixture: Current synthetic W1L1 type-0x7F final-letter archive variant
controls: clear the presentation/stage breakpoint set at 01D7:4FAF and arm only 01D7:5010/5017/5038/503D/5042/5047
transition_release_capacity_probe.interpretation: Even after removing breakpoint-capacity pressure and forcing the non-terminal DS:89E0 value, the synthetic fixture returns to the main loop without executing 01D7:5010 or the downstream reload calls. The handoff and its gate are therefore confirmed, but the fixture still lacks the authored transition state needed to enter the resource/object rebuild branch.

conclusion: The final-letter probe reaches mask 0x7F and performs normal effect/removal. The real outer-state consumer requires DS:89E6 != 0; once gated, 01D7:14E1 reaches the all-seven comparator and completion presentation, adds 2000 points, and sets DS:85DB=1. The new controlled wait/input/audio release proves the native handoff through 01D7:4F10-4FAF and advances DS:85D4 to 0x10. Exact retail timing and the downstream resource/object reload calls at 01D7:5017/5038/5047 still need a non-synthetic completion or a more faithful transition fixture.
